extName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and on the Web Store.

extDescription.message: Live bilingual captions for any tab: the original line and its translation, from your own Gemini API key.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in Chrome and on the Web Store. Must stay under 132 characters.

uiLanguage.description: BCP-47 tag for THIS catalogue's language, used for the document lang attribute. Translators: set it to your own locale, not to a translation of the word.

loadingSettings.description: Shown while the popup or options page reads stored settings.

openOptions.description: Button in the popup that opens the options page.

keyStorageNote.message: API keys are kept only in this device's local Chrome storage.
keyStorageNote.description: Reassurance shown at the bottom of the popup and options page.

statusIdle.description: Popup status pill: no captioning session is running.

statusStarting.description: Popup status pill: a session is being established.

statusRunning.description: Popup status pill: captions are being produced.

statusRetry.description: Popup status pill: the session failed and must be restarted.

providerHeading.description: Heading of the provider section in the popup and options page.

transcriberLabel.description: Label for the dropdown that picks the speech provider.

keysConfigured.description: Popup line telling the user the selected provider has its key.

keysMissing.description: Popup line telling the user the selected provider has no key yet.

resetApiKey.description: Link that reveals a configured API Key field so it can be replaced.

increaseCaptionFont.message: Increase original and translation font sizes
increaseCaptionFont.description: Caption toolbar action that increases both font sizes.

decreaseCaptionFont.message: Decrease original and translation font sizes
decreaseCaptionFont.description: Caption toolbar action that decreases both font sizes.

increaseCaptionBackground.description: Caption toolbar action that increases background opacity.

decreaseCaptionBackground.description: Caption toolbar action that decreases background opacity.

geminiGuideLink.message: How to create a Gemini API key
geminiGuideLink.description: Link from the popup to the first-use Gemini API key guide.

onboardingPageTitle.message: Create a Gemini API key | Bilingual Live Captions
onboardingPageTitle.description: Browser tab title for the Gemini onboarding guide.

onboardingEyebrow.description: Small heading above the onboarding title.

onboardingTitle.description: Main heading of the onboarding guide.

onboardingSubtitle.message: Follow these four steps in Google AI Studio, then paste the key into Bilingual Live Captions.
onboardingSubtitle.description: Introductory copy for the onboarding guide.

onboardingOpenAiStudio.description: Button that opens the Google AI Studio API Keys page.

onboardingStepSignInTitle.message: Sign in to Google AI Studio

onboardingStepSignInBody.message: Open the API Keys page and sign in with your Google Account. If Google shows its terms, review and accept them before continuing.

onboardingStepCreateTitle.message: Use an existing key or create one

onboardingStepCreateBody.message: New users may already have a project and key. If a key is listed, you can skip to step 4. Otherwise, select Create API key.

onboardingStepProjectTitle.message: Name the key and choose a project

onboardingStepProjectBody.message: Name it “Bilingual Live Captions”, choose an imported project, and select Create key. If no project is available, use Import projects first.

onboardingStepCopyTitle.message: Copy the key and set it in the extension

onboardingStepCopyBody.message: Select the Copy icon beside the key. Open the extension popup, paste it into Gemini API Key, then select Set.

onboardingCreateButtonAlt.message: Google AI Studio API Keys page with the Create API key button highlighted.
onboardingCreateButtonAlt.description: Alternative text for the create-button screenshot.

onboardingCreateDialogAlt.message: Create a new key dialog with the key name, project, and Create key button highlighted.
onboardingCreateDialogAlt.description: Alternative text for the create-dialog screenshot.

onboardingCopyKeyAlt.message: Google AI Studio key list with the Copy icon highlighted.
onboardingCopyKeyAlt.description: Alternative text for the copy-key screenshot.

onboardingNotesLabel.description: Accessible label for the onboarding notes section.

onboardingSecurityBody.message: Never share or post your API key. If it is exposed, delete it in AI Studio and create a replacement. The extension keeps it in local Chrome storage on this device.

onboardingBillingBody.message: AI Studio offers a limited free tier. You only need Set up billing if you choose paid usage or need higher limits.

languageHeading.description: Heading of the language section in the popup.

autoDetect.description: The only source-language option in Gemini mode, which detects it itself.

startCaptions.description: Main popup button when no session is running.

stopCaptions.description: Main popup button while a session is running.

working.description: Main popup button while a start or stop request is in flight.

sizeHeading.description: Heading of the font-size and text-color section in the popup.

originalFontSizeLabel.description: Slider label for the source-language font size.

translationFontSizeLabel.description: Slider label for the translated-language font size.

originalTextColorLabel.description: Color picker label for the source-language caption text.

translationTextColorLabel.description: Color picker label for the translated-language caption text.

colorCodeLabel.description: Accessible label for a caption color's hexadecimal text input. $1 is the color field label.

resetTextColors.description: Button that restores both caption text colors.

layoutHeading.description: Heading of the layout section in the popup.

showMoreSettings.description: Summary that reveals the caption style and layout settings in the popup.

clearCaptions.description: Accessible label for the button that clears the current caption window.

backgroundOpacityLabel.description: Slider label for how opaque the caption box background is.

openSidePanel.description: Accessible label for the caption overlay Side Panel button.

captionOverlayTitle.description: Title shown in the floating caption toolbar.

sidePanelTitle.description: Heading in the Chrome Side Panel.

enableAutoScroll.description: Button that resumes following the latest Side Panel caption.

disableAutoScroll.description: Button that pauses following the latest Side Panel caption.

sidePanelWaiting.message: Start captions from the extension popup to see them here.
sidePanelWaiting.description: Side Panel empty state when there is no live session.

sidePanelInactive.message: Captions are now floating on the webpage. Chrome 116 may require you to close this panel manually.
sidePanelInactive.description: Side Panel notice after switching back to the floating overlay.

sidePanelEmpty.description: Side Panel empty state while a session is active.

privacyGemini.message: Once started, the tab's audio is sent to Google Gemini, which returns both the original text and the translation.
privacyGemini.description: Popup footer explaining where audio goes in Gemini mode.

settingsLoadFailed.message: Could not load settings. Please reopen the extension.
settingsLoadFailed.description: Popup error when stored settings cannot be read.

settingsSaveFailed.message: Could not save settings. Please try again.
settingsSaveFailed.description: Popup error when a setting change cannot be written.

optionsOpenFailed.message: Could not open the settings page. Choose "Options" from the extension menu instead.

captionsStopped.description: Popup confirmation after the user stops a session.

stopFailed.description: Popup error when stopping a session fails.

needGeminiKey.message: Enter your Gemini API key first. Get an API Key:
needGeminiKey.description: Popup error when starting in Gemini mode without a key.

startFailed.message: Could not start. Check your API key and the current tab.
startFailed.description: Popup error when starting a session fails for an unknown reason.

backgroundNoResponse.message: The extension's background service did not respond
backgroundNoResponse.description: Error when a message to the service worker gets no usable reply.

needHttpsTab.message: Switch to an https tab that can play video, then start
needHttpsTab.description: Error when the active tab cannot be captioned.

needGeminiKeyField.description: Field-level validation message for the Gemini key.

optionsTitle.description: Heading and document title of the options page.

optionsKeyHint.message: You can clear a key and save. Only the keys your choices need are used: Gemini for Gemini live and for read-ahead with Gemini; Groq for read-ahead with Groq Whisper (translated by Chrome's built-in translation, which needs no key).
optionsKeyHint.description: Explanation under the key fields on the options page.

saving.description: Options page submit button while a save is in flight.

keysLoadFailed.message: Could not load your API keys. Please reload and try again.
keysLoadFailed.description: Options page error when stored keys cannot be read.

keysSaved.description: Options page confirmation after a successful save.

keysSaveFailed.message: Could not save your API keys. Please try again.
keysSaveFailed.description: Options page error when a save fails.

show.description: Button that reveals a masked API key field.

hide.description: Button that masks a revealed API key field.

setApiKey.description: Button that confirms and saves an API key.

showSecret.description: Accessible name for the reveal button. $1 is the field's label.

hideSecret.description: Accessible name for the mask button. $1 is the field's label.

captionTrackLabel.description: Name of the native text track used when a video itself goes fullscreen.

errorGeminiInvalidCredentials.message: That Gemini API key was rejected. Update it on the settings page.

errorGeminiQuotaExceeded.message: Gemini quota is used up. Try later, or switch provider.

errorUnknown.message: The captioning service hit an unknown error. Please restart.
errorUnknown.description: Caption overlay fallback for an unrecognised error code.

geminiConnectionTimedOut.description: Reason reported when Gemini never answers the setup message.

geminiSocketError.description: Reason reported when the Gemini socket raises an error event.

geminiApiError.description: Reason reported when Gemini sends an error frame with no message.

autoFollowAuthorizationHint.message: Open Bilingual Live Captions once to enable automatic captions on this tab
autoFollowAuthorizationHint.description: Toolbar hint shown when an active tab needs one-time authorization for caption auto-follow.

socketClosed.description: Reason reported when the socket closes without giving one. $1 is the close code.

ratingTitle.description: Rating card title in the popup. $1 is the extension name.

ratingStarLabel.description: Accessible label for one star button in the rating card. $1 is a number from 1 to 5.

ratingLater.description: Rating card button that hides the card and asks again later.

ratingNever.description: Rating card button that hides the card for good.

feedbackPrompt.description: Label of the free-text box shown when the feedback drop-down is set to Other.

feedbackPrivacyNote.message: Sends only what you type, your rating, the extension version, provider and UI language. Never your tab URL, API keys or captions.
feedbackPrivacyNote.description: Small print under the feedback form explaining exactly what is sent.

feedbackSending.description: Feedback submit button while the request is in flight.

feedbackThanks.description: Shown after feedback is sent, before the card closes.

feedbackFailed.message: Couldn't send. Check your connection and try again.
feedbackFailed.description: Shown when sending feedback fails. The typed text is kept.

feedbackMessageTooLong.description: Validation error: the feedback text is too long. $1 is the limit.

closeLabel.description: Accessible label for a close (×) button.

websiteLink.description: Popup footer link to the extension's website.

feedbackRetry.description: Feedback submit button after a failed send.

feedbackIssueLabel.description: Label of the optional drop-down in the feedback form.

feedbackIssueNone.description: Empty first option of the feedback drop-down: nothing picked.

feedbackIssueInaccurate.description: Feedback drop-down option: the translation is wrong.

feedbackIssueDelay.description: Feedback drop-down option: captions appear too late.

feedbackIssueUi.message: The interface is hard to use
feedbackIssueUi.description: Feedback drop-down option: the UI is unfriendly.

feedbackIssueOther.description: Feedback drop-down option that reveals a free-text box.

transcriberReadAhead.description: Provider dropdown option for read-ahead mode, which translates upcoming audio so captions appear as the speech starts.

targetHongKongLiveHint.message: Live audio mode has no Hong Kong variant: it translates into Traditional Chinese. Read-ahead mode uses Hong Kong's captions and wording.
targetHongKongLiveHint.description: Popup hint under the target language when live mode is chosen with Hong Kong Traditional Chinese, which Gemini Live Translate has no code for.

errorProviderRateLimited.message: $1 is too busy: it is rate-limiting requests for now. Wait a minute and it recovers, or switch to another speech recognition service.
errorProviderRateLimited.description: Caption overlay error in read-ahead mode, with a suggestion. $1 is the service name.

errorProviderTimeout.message: $1 did not answer within 7 seconds, so this part was skipped. Check your connection; if the service is busy, switch to another speech recognition service.
errorProviderTimeout.description: Caption overlay error in read-ahead mode, with a suggestion. $1 is the service name.

errorProviderInvalidCredentials.message: $1 rejected your key. Check the API key in settings.
errorProviderInvalidCredentials.description: Caption overlay error in read-ahead mode, with a suggestion. $1 is the service name.

errorProviderNetworkError.message: Could not reach $1. Check your connection, VPN or firewall.
errorProviderNetworkError.description: Caption overlay error in read-ahead mode, with a suggestion. $1 is the service name.

errorProviderUnavailable.message: $1 is unavailable right now. Try again later, or switch to another speech recognition service.
errorProviderUnavailable.description: Caption overlay error in read-ahead mode, with a suggestion. $1 is the service name.

errorProviderInvalidResponse.message: $1 sent back something unreadable, so this part was skipped. It is usually a one-off and the next part goes ahead; if it keeps happening, switch services.
errorProviderInvalidResponse.description: Caption overlay error in read-ahead mode, with a suggestion. $1 is the service name.

errorReadAheadPageTimeout.message: This part took over 8.5 seconds and was skipped. If your connection or the service is slow, switch to a faster speech recognition service (Groq).
errorReadAheadPageTimeout.description: Caption overlay error in read-ahead mode, with a suggestion.

errorReadAheadWebTranslationFailed.message: Chrome's built-in translation cannot translate these languages, and Google's web translation, tried instead, failed too. Choose Groq Whisper again in the popup and allow the connection, or set speech recognition to Gemini (with translation).
errorReadAheadWebTranslationFailed.description: Caption overlay error in read-ahead mode, with a suggestion.

recognizerLocal.description: Read-ahead speech recognition option that runs Whisper on the viewer's computer.

localWhisperNoWebGpu.message: Chrome on this computer has no WebGPU, so it cannot run Local Whisper.
localWhisperNoWebGpu.description: Popup hint when WebGPU is unavailable.

localWhisperModelLabel.description: Label of the Local Whisper model choice.

localWhisperModelTurbo.description: Local Whisper model option. $1 is the download size in MB.

localWhisperModelSmall.description: Local Whisper model option. $1 is the download size in MB.

localWhisperDownload.description: Button that starts the Local Whisper model download. $1 is the size in MB.

localWhisperDownloadHint.message: Downloaded once from Hugging Face and kept on this computer; recognition then runs entirely here, with no key and no quota.
localWhisperDownloadHint.description: Hint under the Local Whisper download button.

localWhisperDownloading.message: Downloading… $1 / $2 MB (you can close this window)
localWhisperDownloading.description: Local Whisper download progress. $1 and $2 are megabytes.

localWhisperReady.description: Local Whisper status when the model is downloaded.

localWhisperDelete.description: Button that deletes the Local Whisper model from this computer.

localWhisperDeleteFailed.message: Could not delete the model. Try again.
localWhisperDeleteFailed.description: Popup error when deleting the Local Whisper model fails.

localWhisperDownloadFailed.message: The download failed. Check your connection and try again.
localWhisperDownloadFailed.description: Popup error when the Local Whisper download failed.

localWhisperModelMissing.message: Download the Local Whisper model first.
localWhisperModelMissing.description: Error when starting read-ahead on Local Whisper without its model.

errorLocalWhisperTimeout.message: Local Whisper did not finish within 7 seconds, so this part was skipped. Switch to the smaller model (small), or to Groq Whisper.
errorLocalWhisperTimeout.description: Caption overlay error when Local Whisper is too slow on this computer.

switchToLocalWhisper.description: Caption overlay button after Groq Whisper could not serve, when this computer can run Local Whisper.

errorReadAheadLoading.description: Caption overlay status while read-ahead mode holds the video until it has the audio of the next sentence.

errorReadAheadCaptionsLoading.description: Caption overlay status while read-ahead mode holds the video, at most 2 seconds, to load the video's caption tracks.

noticeReadAheadCaptionsYouTube.description: Caption overlay notice, shown for a few seconds, that read-ahead reads the uploader's YouTube caption track instead of recognizing speech.

noticeReadAheadCaptionsVideo.description: Caption overlay notice, shown for a few seconds, that read-ahead reads the video's own caption track instead of recognizing speech.

recognizerCaptionTrackHint.message: When the video has captions from its uploader, they are used first: no speech recognition, and no translation when there are captions in your language too.
recognizerCaptionTrackHint.description: Popup hint under the read-ahead speech recognition choice.

errorReadAheadTranslating.description: Caption overlay status while read-ahead mode holds the video until the next sentence, whose audio it already has, is translated.

errorReadAheadFailed.description: Caption overlay status over a stretch of media read-ahead mode could not translate.

errorReadAheadUnsupported.message: This site does not support read-ahead mode. Use Gemini live instead.
errorReadAheadUnsupported.description: Caption overlay notice when read-ahead mode cannot run on this page (DRM, live stream, unsupported player).

statusReadAheadUnsupported.message: Read-ahead is not supported here. Use Gemini live instead.
statusReadAheadUnsupported.description: Popup status when read-ahead mode cannot run on this page.

deepgramRemovedNeedGeminiKey.message: Deepgram is no longer supported, so captions now use Gemini live. Set a Gemini API key to continue.
deepgramRemovedNeedGeminiKey.description: Popup notice shown once after the update that removed Deepgram, to a Deepgram user who has no Gemini key yet.

captionModeLabel.description: Label for the dropdown that picks Gemini live or read-ahead mode.

recognizerGemini.description: Read-ahead speech recognition option: Gemini, which also translates.

translatorLabel.description: Label for the read-ahead translation dropdown.

translatorChrome.description: Read-ahead translation option: Chrome's on-device Translator.

needGroqKey.message: Enter your Groq API key first.
needGroqKey.description: Popup error when starting read-ahead with Groq Whisper without a key.

needGroqKeyField.description: Field-level validation message for the Groq key.

groqPermissionDenied.message: Groq Whisper needs permission to reach api.groq.com.
groqPermissionDenied.description: Popup message when the user declines the Groq host permission.

switchToGroqWhisper.description: Caption overlay button shown with a used-up Gemini quota in read-ahead mode.

errorGroqQuotaExceeded.message: Groq's daily quota is used up (about 2,000 requests a day). Switch to Local Whisper or Gemini (with translation), or come back tomorrow.
errorGroqQuotaExceeded.description: Caption overlay error in read-ahead mode with Groq Whisper.

errorReadAheadTranslatorUnsupported.message: Chrome's built-in translation cannot translate this language. Choose Gemini (translates too) for speech recognition instead.
errorReadAheadTranslatorUnsupported.description: Caption overlay error when Chrome translation cannot translate the language pair.

providerSignupLink.description: Link under a provider dropdown. $1 is the provider's sign-up domain.

transcriberLive.description: Translation mode option: Gemini live translate, which captions the tab audio as it plays.

translatorWebFallback.description: Read-ahead translation shown when Chrome's built-in Translator cannot be used and the web fallback takes over.

translatorWebFallbackHintComputer.message: This computer cannot run Chrome's built-in translation, so Google's web translation is used instead. It is not an official API and may stop working.
translatorWebFallbackHintComputer.description: Popup hint when the built-in Translator is missing and the web fallback is used.

translatorWebFallbackHintLanguage.message: Chrome's built-in translation cannot translate these languages, so Google's web translation is used instead. It is not an official API and may stop working.
translatorWebFallbackHintLanguage.description: Popup hint when the built-in Translator cannot do the language pair and the web fallback is used.
